notes:
A web-only app: the page is served by its own server, packaged as ONE Docker image (and a Node tarball). Deliberate differences from the 'self-hosted-server' set: (1) NO server-install-update (no Linux installer/Windows tray: Docker is the install, 'docker compose pull' is the update, written in docs/guides/BACKUP_AND_UPDATE.md), (2) NO updaters (no desktop or Android build), (3) NO cloudflare-access token fields in Settings: the web client is same-origin with the API, so the browser's own Access cookie covers every request; service-token headers are only needed for scripts and are documented in docs/guides/CLOUDFLARE_TUNNEL.md. Revisit all three the day a desktop or Android client exists. Release workflow has docker + node-bundle jobs instead of desktop/android. Standard Notes and Vikunja import/export live in apps/server/src/formats and are checked against the real formats (see docs/development/FORMATS.md). Descriptions are plain text; Vikunja HTML is flattened on import and wrapped in

on export on purpose.
